entry.title: A first stitch through a card
entry.summary: Davies describes supervised sewing with a blunt needle and a card with prepared holes. Her chapter places simple sewing around 2½ years; the illustrated example and appendix begin from 2.
entry.cue: Your child is interested in guiding something through a hole and pulling it from the other side.
detail: Her first card is a small square with holes along a diagonal. The illustrated example uses a blunt darning needle and thread doubled and knotted at the end. Show the needle going into a hole, turn the card over, and pull it through; then try the next hole.

A child may want to repeat just that movement, with help as needed. The book includes scissors in the sewing kit and requires supervision for small parts and sharp tools. Later shapes and elaborate sewing need not be part of this first exploration.
